'''Gebroila''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Shigar Konshi]] and [[Larin Moxla]] went there, as it was the city closest to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s palace.<ref name="Tor: FA" />
